description:
Fill the scaffold stubs in pkix-identity created by PKIX-fmtv.21 with the RFC 6125 §6.4 hostname binding implementation. Scope is the pkix-identity half ONLY; pkix-chain verify_tls_server / verify_tls_client wrappers are split out as PKIX-fmtv.11.2 (blocked on PKIX-fmtv.7's wrapper-set decision, which is human-labeled).

## Deliverable

### pkix-identity changes

Add workspace deps used by this body:
- `idna` 1.x (workspace, no_std with `alloc` feature; std opt-in via crate feature)
- `der` (already a workspace dep; may need extra features for extension parsing)

Implement `ServerName::dns_name(name: &'a str) -> Result<Self, IdentityError>`:
- Validate against LDH + length limits (RFC 952 / RFC 1123 / RFC 5890).
- Lower-case ASCII labels at parse time (case folding done once at construction).
- IDN: if input contains non-ASCII, convert U-label → A-label via `idna` crate before storage.
- Reject empty, overlong, or non-LDH inputs.

Implement `ServerName::ip_address(ip: &'a str) -> Result<Self, IdentityError>`:
- Parse as IPv4 dotted-quad or IPv6 (with or without brackets).
- Store as canonical 4-byte or 16-byte buffer.
- Reject malformed inputs.

Implement `verify_dns_name(cert: &Certificate, name: &ServerName) -> Result<(), IdentityError>`:
- Parse leaf's SubjectAlternativeName extension (OID 2.5.29.17); iterate `GeneralName` entries.
- For each `GeneralName::DnsName(dns)`: apply RFC 6125 §6.4 matching against `name`:
  - **Exact** case-insensitive ASCII match (case folding already done at `name` parse time; SAN entry folded inline).
  - **Wildcard** rules: SAN entry `"*.foo.com"` matches `"a.foo.com"` but NOT `"a.b.foo.com"` (single leftmost label only), NOT bare `"*"`, NOT `"*.com"` (no public-suffix check — caller responsibility per scope discipline), NOT embedded wildcards (`"*.foo.*.com"` rejected).
  - **IDN** SANs: SAN is already in A-label form (CABF requires); compare against A-label `name`.
- For each `GeneralName::IpAddress(bytes)`: if `name` is an IP literal (4 or 16 bytes), byte-equal compare.
- If any SAN entry matches: `Ok(())`.
- If SAN present but no entry matches: `Err(IdentityError::NoMatchingSan)`.
- If SAN missing: `Err(IdentityError::MissingSan)`.
- Do NOT consult Subject DN CN (deprecated by RFC 6125 §6.4.4).

## Test corpus

bettertls.com hostname-matching corpus is already vendored in `pkix-difftest` (per AGENTS.md). Wire it through the new `verify_dns_name` API.

Additional unit tests:
- Wildcard edge cases: leftmost-label-only, no-embedded-wildcards, no-bare-asterisk.
- IDN: U-label input → A-label SAN match, both directions.
- IP literal: IPv4 / IPv6 / mismatched length.
- SAN missing → `MissingSan`.
- SAN present, no match → `NoMatchingSan`.
- CN-only cert (no SAN): rejected with `MissingSan` (CN fallback intentionally not performed).

## Out of scope (split to PKIX-fmtv.11.2)

- `pkix_chain::verify_tls_server` / `verify_tls_client` wrappers — depend on PKIX-fmtv.7 (human-labeled, wrapper-set decision).
- New `VerifyError` variants in pkix-chain.

## Acceptance

- `cargo build -p pkix-identity` clean (default features + `--no-default-features`).
- `cargo build -p pkix-identity --target wasm32-unknown-unknown --no-default-features` clean (no_std preserved).
- `cargo clippy -p pkix-identity --all-targets --all-features -- -D warnings` clean.
- bettertls corpus integration test passing.
- CHANGELOG entry in `pkix-identity/CHANGELOG.md` and top-level CHANGELOG.

## What this unblocks

PKIX-fmtv.11.2 (pkix-chain TLS wrappers, still blocked on .7) and any future pkix-chain caller that wants hostname binding without the wrapper convenience.
title: Implement RFC 6125 hostname binding body in pkix-identity (verify_dns_name + ServerName constructors)
